Requirement: Patient statements shall be saved verbatim only after the robot reads them back and the patient confirms; unconfirmed statements shall not be saved.
Robot event records shall be limited to the robot's own actions and the responses it received; mood, symptoms, intake and appearance shall not be inferred.
Every sentence shown or sent shall cite record IDs and pass the grounding checker (rules R1-R9); a failed sentence shall be replaced by template wording and audited.
Missing values shall be stated as 'no reading'; readings older than the configured stale limit shall show their age.
Care-team replies shall be shown and read verbatim with sender and received time and shall never be summarized or reworded.
Records shall be append-only with a hash chain; a daily integrity check shall verify the chain and that every citation resolves.
Notify values and reminders shall be labelled as care-team settings; the robot shall only compare values and report the comparison.
Simulated blood glucose shall be stored in mg/dL as entered with its source; the robot shall never estimate a glucose value.
Replies to a patient symptom statement shall offer care-team contact and the call-button line; no state shall claim help is coming.
